improvement_loop.name: Observe
actions: Collect approved website and agent measurements.
Check data quality and collection coverage.
Compare results with confirmed objectives and baselines.

improvement_loop.name: Detect
actions: Identify regressions, anomalies, and recurring failures.
Separate real incidents from measurement errors.
Prioritize by user impact, business importance, and risk.

improvement_loop.name: Diagnose
actions: Gather relevant logs and test results.
Generate competing explanations where appropriate.
Label suspected causes as hypotheses until validated.

improvement_loop.name: Recommend
actions: Propose improvements with expected benefits and tradeoffs.
Identify affected workflows, pages, integrations, and risks.
Determine whether clarification or approval is required.

improvement_loop.name: Authorize
actions: Check the decision and approval gates.
Confirm the scope and rollback strategy.
Block actions that lack required authorization.

improvement_loop.name: Implement and test
actions: Apply the approved change.
Run relevant functional, accessibility, security, and regression tests.
Validate critical journeys before release.

improvement_loop.name: Measure
actions: Compare results with a compatible baseline.
Record whether the expected outcome was achieved.
Identify side effects and regressions.

improvement_loop.name: Learn
actions: Record the outcome and evidence.
Update project-specific knowledge when authorized.
Add recurring failures to evaluation tests.
Revisit assumptions and decisions affected by the findings.

feedback_routing.business_or_audience_mismatch: Route findings to discovery and business understanding.
feedback_routing.workflow_failure: Route findings to workflow intelligence and validation.
feedback_routing.content_or_search_issue: Route findings to content and SEO intelligence.
feedback_routing.technical_or_integration_issue: Route findings to technology and integration intelligence.
feedback_routing.privacy_or_security_issue: Route findings to compliance, security, and human approval processes.
feedback_routing.repeated_agent_failure: Route findings to agent evaluation, prompts, tools, and knowledge retrieval.

learning_boundaries: Do not automatically turn a single incident into a universal industry rule.
Separate reusable industry knowledge from customer-specific project knowledge.
Preserve source provenance and version history.
Require review before promoting unverified observations into authoritative knowledge.
Do not use performance optimization to bypass Layer 9 decision gates.
